$comment: The Chart docs page's examples and the charts gallery (registry/new-york-v4/charts) map here. Waiting: chart-area-interactive (Select). The gallery's bar, pie, radar, radial and tooltip charts come with the chart units that port those charts, and are mapped here when they land.

chart-demo.reason: Upstream's example imports the new-york-v4 registry's Card, which none of Joinery's eight styles is. The parity stage gives this full-width example no width, so the card collapses: Nova's Card clips what overflows it (overflow-hidden), new-york-v4's doesn't. Measured at 11.57% (dark).

chart-area-default.reason: The charts gallery draws its card with the new-york-v4 registry's Card (24px spacing, a shadow, a semibold title, no footer band), which none of Joinery's eight styles is; Joinery's draws in Nova. The chart inside it matches recharts' (the Chart page's examples, which have no card, compare at 0%). Measured at 16.60% (dark).
